definitions.gloss: menma, seasoned bamboo shoots for ramen
definitions.explanation: Fermented and seasoned bamboo shoot strips, commonly used as a ramen topping. Also eaten as a side dish or snack with beer.

examples.japanese: ラーメンにメンマをのせる。
メンマの{食感|しょっかん}が{好|す}きだ。
examples.english: I like the texture of menma.

examples.japanese: ビールのおつまみに{味付|あじつ}けメンマを{買|か}ってきた。
examples.english: I bought seasoned menma as a snack to go with beer.

notes:
USAGE:
One of the standard toppings for ramen alongside チャーシュー ({叉焼|チャーシュー}), {海苔|のり}, and {煮卵|にたまご}. Also sold pre-seasoned in packages at supermarkets and convenience stores as a snack or side dish.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- メンマをのせる (place menma on top)
- {味付|あじつ}けメンマ (seasoned menma)
- メンマトッピング (menma topping)
- {自家製|じかせい}メンマ (homemade menma)

ETYMOLOGY:
A blend of メン (from ラーメン, ramen) and マ (from {麻|ま}{竹|ちく}, a type of bamboo). Originally called シナチク, but the name was changed as シナ was considered offensive.
